results.controlIntent: a. Conduct a risk assessment, including: 1. Identifying system threats and vulnerabilities; 2. Determining the likelihood and magnitude of harm from unauthorized access, use, disclosure, disruption, modification, or destruction of the system, the information it processes, stores, or transmits, and any related information; and 3. Determining the likelihood and impact of adverse effects on individuals arising from the processing of personally identifiable information; b. Combine system-level risk assessments with risk assessment results and risk management decisions from the organization and mission or business process perspectives; c. Document risk assessment results in [Selection: security and privacy plans; risk assessment report; [Assignment: organization-defined document]]; d. At [Assignment: organization-defined frequency], review risk assessment results; e. Provide risk assessment results to [Assignment: organization-defined personnel or roles]; and f. Update the risk assessment [Assignment: organization-defined frequency] or when there are significant changes to the system, its environment of operation, or other conditions that may impact the security or privacy state of the system.

gaps: No model card exists for churn-predictor-v1; a model card (or equivalent risk assessment report/security plan) documenting threats, vulnerabilities, likelihood/magnitude of harm, and PII impact analysis is required.
No evidence of organizational or mission/business-process-level risk assessment integration.
No evidence of a defined review frequency or record of periodic risk assessment reviews.
No evidence that risk assessment results have been distributed to defined personnel or roles.
No evidence of a defined update frequency or change-triggered update process for the risk assessment.

Human attestation would be needed to confirm whether any off-system risk assessment documentation (e.g., in a GRC tool, SharePoint, or paper records) exists that was not captured by the available collector.
